settings.name: OIDF_OPENBAO_URL
settings.description: OpenBao's address, for hosted agents' signing keys (one transit key each) and the attester's, read as one setting by both; unset, the first of OPENBAO_ADDR, BAO_ADDR and VAULT_ADDR that is set, with a warning

when_wrong.detail: A superseded name set to another value than this: hosting and the attester do not start. Missing or wrong: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500

settings.name: OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN
settings.description: The OpenBao token for the same, read as one setting by both, or from the file OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN_FILE names; unset, the first of OPENBAO_TOKEN, BAO_TOKEN and VAULT_TOKEN that is set, with a warning

when_wrong.detail: A superseded name set to another value than this: hosting and the attester do not start. Missing or refused: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500
